Cardinal Capital Management Decreased Apple Computer (AAPL) Position by $313,292 as Stock Rose; Facebook (FB) Position Maintained by Scholtz & Company Llc
June 16, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Amy Minella decreased its stake in Apple Computer (AAPL) by 4.73% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cardinal Capital Management sold 1,876 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Amy Minella held 37,753 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.33M, down from 39,629 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cardinal Capital Management who had been investing in Apple Computer for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $928.18B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.03% or $1.96 during the last trading session, reaching $188.84. About 33.10M shares traded or 9.56% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
